title: Schedule of Entry Terms and Agreement Limits, Grain Storage and Conditioning Agreements
content:
Licensed space at Prairie Ridge Cooperative Association is let programme by programme, and the terms on which grain is signed in are posted in this schedule. It governs Grain Storage and Conditioning Agreements across all six programmes.

## 1. The terms an agreement is opened on

1.1 An agreement covers one commodity of one crop year at one facility. The programme it is written under fixes the smallest deposit the agreement will be opened for in whole bushels, the most bushels one agreement may carry, the one-off fee charged when the agreement is accepted, the shortest term the agreement may run for in calendar days, the bushels of licensed space the agreement reserves for the member, and the longest the grain may stay in store under the agreement before it must move, counted in calendar days.

1.2 Alongside those terms each programme posts an entry gate: the bushels the agreement will be opened at, whether a signed storage agreement is required, whether the member's own stored-grain insurance certificate is required, and which commodities the programme will hold.

## 2. Posted terms by programme

| Programme | Smallest deposit (bu) | Most bushels one agreement may carry | Setup fee (USD) | Shortest term (days) | Licensed space reserved (bu) | Longest time in store (days) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Open Storage Account | 1 | 150000 | 0.00 | 0 | 0 | 365 |
| Grain Bank Deposit Account | 500 | 60000 | 25.00 | 60 | 0 | 365 |
| Commercial Warehouse Receipt Storage | 5000 | 400000 | 50.00 | 90 | 0 | 730 |
| Seasonal Paid-Up Storage Agreement | 5000 | 300000 | 40.00 | 180 | 0 | 365 |
| Conditioned Reserve Storage Agreement | 10000 | 500000 | 125.00 | 180 | 25000 | 730 |
| Identity Preserved Segregated Storage | 15000 | 250000 | 250.00 | 120 | 60000 | 400 |

## 3. Entry gate by programme

| Programme | Bushels to open | Signed storage agreement | Insurance certificate | Commodities held |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Open Storage Account | 1 | not required | not required | any licensed commodity |
| Grain Bank Deposit Account | 500 | required | not required | feed grains only |
| Commercial Warehouse Receipt Storage | 5000 | required | required | licensed grains only |
| Seasonal Paid-Up Storage Agreement | 5000 | required | not required | corn and soybeans only |
| Conditioned Reserve Storage Agreement | 10000 | required | required | licensed grains only |
| Identity Preserved Segregated Storage | 15000 | required | required | contracted identity preserved lots only |

## 4. Footnotes to the schedule

(a) A reserved space of nil means the programme holds no licensed space aside for the member; the two programmes that do reserve space hold 25000 bushels and 60000 bushels respectively.

(b) A shortest term of nil days means the agreement runs for no minimum period.

(c) A setup fee of 0.00 means no fee is raised when the agreement is accepted into store.

## 5. Worked selection, on hypothetical figures

A member offering 4000 bushels of oats meets the smallest deposit posted for the Open Storage Account, which opens at 1 bushel, and for the Grain Bank Deposit Account, which opens at 500 bushels, but falls short of the 5000 bushels at which the Commercial Warehouse Receipt Storage and the Seasonal Paid-Up Storage Agreement open, and well short of the 10000 and 15000 bushels at which the two highest programmes open. Oats being a feed grain and a licensed commodity, the commodity restriction bars neither of the two programmes the quantity reaches.
